fix(camellia): persist pagination state in url

Summary:
- add shared Camellia pagination helpers and a stored default page-size setting
- update DataTable and SimpleCrudPage to honor URL pn/ps and frontend defaults
- wire manual pagination pages and list/detail routes to preserve query state

Rationale:
- DAM-64 requires all paginated pages to reuse a configurable default page size
- browser back was losing list context because page state lived only in component state
- URL-driven pagination avoids per-page drift and covers client-side tables too

Tests:
- cd theaceae && pnpm run typecheck:camellia
